description: Geodesic distance and bearings on the WGS-84 ellipsoid: Vincenty (millimetre accuracy) plus great-circle haversine, initial / final bearing with 16-point compass, midpoint, multi-point path length with per-segment legs, and the destination point from a start, bearing and distance. Units km, m, mi, nautical miles or feet. Offline, deterministic. Returns JSON with: units, distance, greatCircle, method, initialBearing, finalBearing, compass, midpoint. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/geo-distance

distance.description: Distance to travel in the chosen units (destination mode)
